tactics: intro α a motive a_1 t F
intro α a motive a_1 t F <;> exact F _ t (by induction t <;> constructor <;> first | assumption | (constructor <;> first | assumption | (apply F <;> assumption)))

intro α a motive a_1 t F <;> have h : motive a_1 t ∧ List.Mem.below (motive := motive) t := by induction t with | head as => exact ⟨F _ _ (by constructor), by constructor⟩ | tail b h ih => exact ⟨F _ _ (by constructor <;> assumption), by constructor <;> assumption⟩
